name: Imp Rush stays off when its autocast toggle is off, in aggressive and defensive stance (#9211)
contract: Issue #9211 reports the Greater Imp's Imp Rush (630931) fires on its own in aggressive or defensive stance no matter how its pet-bar autocast toggle is set. Server side, the pet's only combat driver is the core PetAI autocast loop (PetAI::UpdateAI), which only considers a harmful spell once it is present in Pet::m_autospells; Pet::ToggleAutocast adds or removes the spell id from that list and the CMSG_PET_SPELL_AUTOCAST opcode (exercised here through the pet_autocast action) is the player's own toggle. Nothing in src/server/coa/AscensionXoroth*.cpp casts 630931 directly or bypasses that list. Expected: with the toggle explicitly off, the imp lands no Imp Rush hits while aggressive, and still none after switching to defensive with the same live target; after the player turns the toggle back on, the imp lands at least one Imp Rush hit within its 30s cooldown.

steps.label: Force the Greater Imp passive aura
SETUP: the Greater Imp passive teaches Summon: Greater Imp
SETUP: the Greater Imp is the knight's pet
SETUP: the pet knows Imp Rush
SETUP: Imp Rush autocast is off
Let the imp swing for a while, aggressive
Imp Rush never lands while off and aggressive
Defensive stance, still fighting the dummy
Let the imp keep swinging, defensive
Imp Rush never lands while off and defensive
Turn Imp Rush autocast back on
SETUP: Imp Rush autocast is on
Imp Rush lands once the toggle is back on
